import asyncio
class Entry:
 def __contains__(self,key): return key=="x"
 def __delitem__(self,key): self.deleted=key
class Manager(dict):
 async def __aenter__(self): return Entry()
 async def __aexit__(self,*args): pass
async def run():
 async with Manager() as d:
  if "x" in d: del d["x"]
 assert d.deleted=="x" and not hasattr(d,"pop")
asyncio.run(run())
